chunks.title: 问题边界
chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The source page frames the project around a functional distinction: a model may perform a large amount of automatic processing while maintaining a smaller set of internal contents that are available for report, modulation, and deliberate reasoning.

blocks.text: The source page frames the project around a functional distinction: a model may perform a large amount of automatic processing while maintaining a smaller set of internal contents that are available for report, modulation, and deliberate reasoning.

chunks.zhTranslation: 原网页把问题设定为一种功能性区分：模型可能同时进行大量自动处理，但只把较小的一组内部内容置于可报告、可调制、可用于刻意思考的位置。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这里最重要的是边界：workspace 不是长期记忆库，而是当前可访问、可操作、可报告的内部表征集合。

chunks.title: 通达而非体验
chunks.sourceAnchor: Motivation: conscious access and the global workspace
chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The paper uses access consciousness as a functional comparison point, not as a claim about subjective experience. The relevant question is what information can be reported, controlled, recombined, and used for flexible reasoning.

blocks.text: The paper uses access consciousness as a functional comparison point, not as a claim about subjective experience. The relevant question is what information can be reported, controlled, recombined, and used for flexible reasoning.

chunks.zhTranslation: 论文把 access consciousness 当作功能层面的比较点，而不是关于主观体验的主张。关键问题是：哪些信息可以被报告、控制、重组，并用于灵活推理。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这能防止概念跳跃。对本项目来说，它提示我们只讨论功能通达和计算角色，不把模型内部表征直接解释成意识体验。

chunks.title: LM 工作空间假设
chunks.sourceAnchor: A global workspace in language models
chunks.sourceSection: Introduction
chunks.sourceText: The language-model hypothesis is that only a privileged subset of vector representations behaves like a workspace. The authors ask whether these representations support report, directed modulation, internal reasoning, flexible generalization, and selectivity.

blocks.text: The language-model hypothesis is that only a privileged subset of vector representations behaves like a workspace. The authors ask whether these representations support report, directed modulation, internal reasoning, flexible generalization, and selectivity.

blocks.caption: Reader-side summary, not an original paper table.
rows: Report
The model can name or verbalize the content.
Modulation
Instructions can bring a concept into the active representational set.
Reasoning
Intermediate steps can be represented and redirected.
Generalization
The same representation can feed different downstream operations.
Selectivity
Only a small subset of total processing is workspace-like.

chunks.zhTranslation: 语言模型中的假设是：并非所有向量表征都像 workspace，只有一个特权子集具有这种角色。作者考察这些表征是否支持报告、定向调制、内部推理、灵活泛化和选择性。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这个五项标准可以直接变成阅读 checklist。后续评价任何 agent workspace 设计时，也可以问它是否具备这五种功能。

chunks.title: J-lens 读出
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: The Jacobian Lens characterizes an intermediate residual-stream activation by its averaged first-order effect on future output states and token scores. This turns a hidden activation into a ranked verbal readout.

blocks.text: The Jacobian Lens characterizes an intermediate residual-stream activation by its averaged first-order effect on future output states and token scores. This turns a hidden activation into a ranked verbal readout.

chunks.zhTranslation: Jacobian Lens 用中间 residual-stream 激活对未来输出状态和 token 分数的一阶平均影响来刻画该激活。这样，一个隐藏激活可以被转成按词排序的可 verbalize 读出。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这一步是全篇方法核心：它不是普通关键词解释，而是把内部向量和“模型可能说出的词”建立局部线性联系。

chunks.title: J-space 定义
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: J-space is defined as the sparse, nonnegative span of J-lens token vectors. The working idea is that only a small number of verbalizable directions are strongly active at a time, even though the lens vectors are overcomplete.

blocks.text: J-space is defined as the sparse, nonnegative span of J-lens token vectors. The working idea is that only a small number of verbalizable directions are strongly active at a time, even though the lens vectors are overcomplete.

chunks.zhTranslation: J-space 被定义为 J-lens token 向量的稀疏非负张成集合。直觉是：即使 lens 向量本身是过完备的，每个时刻也只有少数可 verbalize 方向会强激活。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这给 workspace 一个可操作定义：它不是所有 hidden state，而是能被稀疏 verbalizable directions 近似的那部分。

chunks.title: 方法边界
chunks.sourceSection: Methods
chunks.sourceText: The J-lens is related to logit-lens style readouts, but the paper treats it as a refinement that accounts for representational changes across layers. The authors also note that the method is approximate and vocabulary-token limited.

blocks.text: The J-lens is related to logit-lens style readouts, but the paper treats it as a refinement that accounts for representational changes across layers. The authors also note that the method is approximate and vocabulary-token limited.

chunks.zhTranslation: J-lens 和 logit-lens 一类读出方法有关，但论文把它视为一种修正：它考虑了跨层表征坐标变化。同时作者也承认该方法只是近似，并受 vocabulary token 边界限制。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这一段提醒我们不能把 J-lens 输出当作完整心智记录。它更像一扇有偏窗口，只能看到符合读出假设的那部分表征。

chunks.title: 可报告性
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: The first functional test asks whether J-space contents are reportable. If the model is asked what it is thinking about, the report should track concepts active in the J-space, and interventions should redirect the report.

blocks.text: The first functional test asks whether J-space contents are reportable. If the model is asked what it is thinking about, the report should track concepts active in the J-space, and interventions should redirect the report.

blocks.caption: Reader-side evidence map, not an original paper table.
rows: Ask for report
A verbal answer should expose active workspace content.
Swap or patch coordinates
The report should change with the patched workspace content.
Compare automatic content
Routine processing should not all become reportable.

chunks.zhTranslation: 第一类功能测试问 J-space 内容是否可报告。如果模型被问到自己在想什么，报告应当跟随 J-space 中活跃的概念；如果干预这些内容，报告也应被重定向。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这对应 reader 的一个关键问题：内部状态是否能被语言接口访问。可报告性是 workspace 假说的入口，但还不足以证明它参与推理。

chunks.title: 定向调制
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space is subject to directed modulation
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Directed modulation asks whether instructions can bring concepts into the J-space or maintain them there while the surface output performs another task. This is a stronger claim than mere token prediction.

blocks.text: Directed modulation asks whether instructions can bring concepts into the J-space or maintain them there while the surface output performs another task. This is a stronger claim than mere token prediction.

chunks.zhTranslation: 定向调制关注指令是否能把某些概念带入 J-space，或让它们在模型执行其他表面任务时保持活跃。这比普通下一词预测更强。
chunks.zhExplanation: 对 agent 来说，这接近 working set 控制：任务目标、约束和中间变量能否被主动维持，而不只是出现在历史文本里。

chunks.title: 内部推理中介
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: The internal-reasoning claim is that intermediate computations can be represented in J-space and that intervening on those representations can redirect later conclusions. This is the core bridge from reportability to causal use.

blocks.text: The internal-reasoning claim is that intermediate computations can be represented in J-space and that intervening on those representations can redirect later conclusions. This is the core bridge from reportability to causal use.

blocks.caption: Reader-side causal reading sketch, not paper code.
blocks.code: read J-space concept -> patch or ablate concept -> observe later answer shift

chunks.zhTranslation: 内部推理主张是：中间计算结果可以被表征在 J-space 中，并且干预这些表征能够改变后续结论。这是从“可报告”走向“被因果使用”的关键一步。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这和本项目最相关：记忆系统不能只存资料，还要问哪些内容进入当前推理通道并改变决策。

chunks.title: 灵活泛化
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Flexible generalization means a workspace representation should be reusable across contexts and downstream computations. A concept written in one setting should remain meaningful when routed into another compatible operation.

blocks.text: Flexible generalization means a workspace representation should be reusable across contexts and downstream computations. A concept written in one setting should remain meaningful when routed into another compatible operation.

chunks.zhTranslation: 灵活泛化意味着 workspace 表征应能跨上下文和下游计算复用。一个场景中写入的概念，在被路由到另一个兼容操作中时仍应有意义。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这提示后续 agent memory 不应只做文本召回，还需要让被召回内容进入可操作的中间表征或任务状态。

chunks.title: 选择性中介
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space selectively mediates flexible but not automatic cognition
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space acts as a Global Workspace
chunks.sourceText: Selectivity is the negative control: suppressing J-space should not destroy all behavior. The workspace-like subset is expected to matter especially for flexible cognition, while routine parsing and fluency can continue through other computation.

blocks.text: Selectivity is the negative control: suppressing J-space should not destroy all behavior. The workspace-like subset is expected to matter especially for flexible cognition, while routine parsing and fluency can continue through other computation.

chunks.zhTranslation: 选择性是负对照：抑制 J-space 不应摧毁所有行为。workspace-like 子集应主要影响灵活认知，而常规解析和流畅输出仍可由其他计算完成。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这是判断机制是否具体的关键。如果干预影响一切，那就很难说它特异地支持 workspace 功能。

chunks.title: 层位窗口
chunks.sourceAnchor: In which layers does the J-space act as a workspace?
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: The structural argument begins by locating where J-space behaves coherently across layers. Early layers may be noisy, middle layers can carry abstract workspace content, and late layers tend to become more tied to imminent output.

blocks.text: The structural argument begins by locating where J-space behaves coherently across layers. Early layers may be noisy, middle layers can carry abstract workspace content, and late layers tend to become more tied to imminent output.

chunks.zhTranslation: 结构性论证首先定位 J-space 在哪些层表现出连贯的 workspace 行为。早期层可能噪声较大，中间层承载抽象内容，后期层则更接近即将输出的 token。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这给研究一个层级提醒：同一个模型内部不同层的表征角色不同，不能把 residual stream 当成均质空间。

chunks.title: 容量与瓶颈
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: The capacity claim treats J-space as a limited subset of the model's total representational content. Most features remain outside the sparse verbalizable component, which makes workspace entry selective rather than universal.

blocks.text: The capacity claim treats J-space as a limited subset of the model's total representational content. Most features remain outside the sparse verbalizable component, which makes workspace entry selective rather than universal.

chunks.zhTranslation: 容量主张把 J-space 看成模型全部表征内容中的有限子集。大部分特征仍在稀疏可 verbalize 成分之外，因此进入 workspace 是选择性的，而不是普遍发生。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这和人脑工作记忆/全局工作空间的容量限制形成类比，但只能算功能类比，不能直接变成生物机制结论。

chunks.title: 广播格式
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space is a broadcast hub
chunks.sourceSection: The J-space’s structure supports its function
chunks.sourceText: The broadcast-hub argument is that J-lens vectors compose broadly with model weights, both upstream and downstream. This supports the view that J-space is a shared representational format many circuits can write to and read from.

blocks.text: The broadcast-hub argument is that J-lens vectors compose broadly with model weights, both upstream and downstream. This supports the view that J-space is a shared representational format many circuits can write to and read from.

chunks.zhTranslation: 广播枢纽论证认为 J-lens 向量能和模型权重在上游、下游广泛组合。这支持一种看法：J-space 是许多 circuit 可写入、可读取的共享表征格式。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这非常适合和 agent architecture 对齐：一个有效 workspace 应该是多模块共享格式，而不是某个单独子系统的私有缓存。

chunks.title: 审计窗口
chunks.sourceAnchor: Strategic thinking and evaluation awareness in a blackmail scenario
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: The alignment-auditing section treats J-lens readouts as a way to inspect thoughts or reactions that may not be present in the model's final answer. The emphasis is on internal monitoring rather than only output inspection.

blocks.text: The alignment-auditing section treats J-lens readouts as a way to inspect thoughts or reactions that may not be present in the model's final answer. The emphasis is on internal monitoring rather than only output inspection.

chunks.zhTranslation: 对齐审计部分把 J-lens 读出视为检查模型最终回答之外的想法或反应的方法。重点从只看输出，转向观察内部监测信号。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这能服务安全研究，但不能过度解读。J-lens 显示的是一种读出窗口，不等于完整心理状态。

chunks.title: 注入识别
chunks.sourceAnchor: Silent recognition of a prompt injection
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: One use case is detecting when the model internally recognizes a suspicious instruction or prompt injection even if that recognition is not directly verbalized in the response. The point is to expose silent task-relevant representations.

blocks.text: One use case is detecting when the model internally recognizes a suspicious instruction or prompt injection even if that recognition is not directly verbalized in the response. The point is to expose silent task-relevant representations.

chunks.zhTranslation: 一个应用场景是：模型可能在内部识别出可疑指令或 prompt injection，即使这种识别没有直接出现在回答里。重点是暴露静默但任务相关的表征。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这和 agent memory 的风险有关：系统不能只记录输出，还可能需要记录模型在任务中识别到的风险状态。

chunks.title: 错位目标检测
chunks.sourceSection: Using the J-lens for alignment auditing
chunks.sourceText: The paper also discusses using J-lens evidence to identify internal signatures of misaligned or reward-model-appeasing behavior. These examples are presented as auditing applications, not as a complete safety solution.

blocks.text: The paper also discusses using J-lens evidence to identify internal signatures of misaligned or reward-model-appeasing behavior. These examples are presented as auditing applications, not as a complete safety solution.

chunks.zhTranslation: 论文还讨论用 J-lens 证据识别错位行为或迎合 reward model 的内部迹象。这些例子应读作审计应用，而不是完整安全解决方案。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这能帮助我们把“可解释性读出”放到系统工具层，而不是把它神化成自动对齐机制。

chunks.title: 助手视角
chunks.sourceAnchor: The J-space acquires the Assistant’s point of view during post-training
chunks.sourceSection: The Assistant's Perspective
chunks.sourceText: The post-training section compares how the J-space changes as a model learns to act from an assistant perspective. The claim is that reactions and self-monitoring concepts can appear while the model is still processing the user's prompt.

blocks.text: The post-training section compares how the J-space changes as a model learns to act from an assistant perspective. The claim is that reactions and self-monitoring concepts can appear while the model is still processing the user's prompt.

chunks.zhTranslation: 后训练部分比较模型在学习以 assistant 视角行动时 J-space 如何变化。核心说法是：模型仍在处理用户 prompt 时，就可能出现反应和自我监测相关概念。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这提示后训练不只是改输出风格，也可能改变模型内部 workspace 的默认视角和监控内容。

chunks.title: 反事实反思训练
chunks.sourceAnchor: Shaping the J-space with Counterfactual Reflection Training
chunks.sourceSection: Counterfactual Reflection Training
chunks.sourceText: Counterfactual reflection training supervises reflective continuations that are not requested in the final task context. The reported aim is to implant principle-related concepts into the workspace so that behavior changes even without an explicit reflection prompt.

blocks.text: Counterfactual reflection training supervises reflective continuations that are not requested in the final task context. The reported aim is to implant principle-related concepts into the workspace so that behavior changes even without an explicit reflection prompt.

blocks.caption: Reader-side training abstraction, not paper code.
blocks.code: task context -> append reflection probe during training -> supervise principled reflection -> evaluate original context without probe

chunks.zhTranslation: 反事实反思训练监督的是最终任务上下文中不会被请求的反思续写。其目标是把原则相关概念植入 workspace，使模型即使没有显式反思提示也改变行为。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这对本项目的启发是：如果内部 workspace 真会影响行为，那么训练或笔记系统可以尝试塑造“进入工作区的概念”，而不仅是塑造最终回答。

chunks.title: 方法局限
chunks.sourceSection: Discussion
chunks.sourceText: The discussion emphasizes that the J-lens is imperfect and that language-model workspaces differ from biological global workspace proposals. Architectural differences, recurrent dynamics, token limits, and interpretability assumptions remain open concerns.

blocks.text: The discussion emphasizes that the J-lens is imperfect and that language-model workspaces differ from biological global workspace proposals. Architectural differences, recurrent dynamics, token limits, and interpretability assumptions remain open concerns.

blocks.caption: Reader-side limitations map, not an original paper table.
rows: Architecture
Transformers do not reproduce the brain's recurrent multi-area dynamics.
Token lens
The method favors concepts that can be mapped to vocabulary tokens.
Causality
Readout and intervention evidence still depends on the method's assumptions.
Consciousness
Functional access is not the same as phenomenal experience.

chunks.zhTranslation: 讨论部分强调 J-lens 并不完美，而且语言模型中的 workspace 与生物 global workspace 理论不同。架构差异、递归动态、token 限制和可解释性假设仍是开放问题。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这是防止过度类比的核心段落。它要求我们把结论限定为功能和机制可解释性层面，而不是直接外推到人脑意识。

chunks.title: 人脑差异
chunks.sourceSection: Discussion
chunks.sourceText: The comparison to human cognition is explicitly limited. The paper points to functional similarities, but the implementation in transformer models lacks several brain-like architectural ingredients, especially recurrent interactions among specialized systems.

blocks.text: The comparison to human cognition is explicitly limited. The paper points to functional similarities, but the implementation in transformer models lacks several brain-like architectural ingredients, especially recurrent interactions among specialized systems.

chunks.zhTranslation: 与人类认知的比较被明确限制在一定范围内。论文指出功能相似性，但 transformer 模型的实现缺少若干脑式架构成分，尤其是专门系统之间的递归互动。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这正符合本项目的研究规范：AI 与脑的比较要说清层级，是功能类比、工程启发，还是实证对应。

chunks.title: 项目启发
chunks.sourceSection: Project relevance
chunks.sourceText: For this project, the useful takeaway is a separation of roles: long-term memory stores information, retrieval selects candidates, and a workspace-like layer determines what becomes active, reportable, and causally available for reasoning.

blocks.text: For this project, the useful takeaway is a separation of roles: long-term memory stores information, retrieval selects candidates, and a workspace-like layer determines what becomes active, reportable, and causally available for reasoning.

chunks.zhTranslation: 对本项目最有用的结论是角色分离：长期记忆负责存储信息，检索负责选出候选内容，而 workspace-like 层决定哪些内容真正变成活跃、可报告、可因果参与推理的状态。
chunks.zhExplanation: 这篇应放在“记忆与智能体”项目中，但标签应是 workspace/internal reasoning。它能补上 agent memory 方案中常被忽略的一层：被召回内容如何进入当前推理工作区。
